summary: **Claude is the most-recommended rival** (**51.8%** visibility, **7.2%** SoV), ahead of Google (42.4%) and our own OpenAI brand (42.0%) — the competitive set to design against.

Use cases are evenly tracked (~**10 prompts each** across Writing, Pricing, Privacy, Research) but performance isn't: **Pricing (75%)** and **Writing (75%)** lead, while **API (25%)** and **Coding (32%)** lag.
In **Coding**, Claude leads on both mentions (**333 vs 327**) and sentiment (**+25 vs +13**); in **API** the whole category is weak (ChatGPT net **−15**) — a category-defining opening.
**2,524 distinct fan-out queries** branch off tracked prompts — adjacent jobs-to-be-done the product and docs could own before rivals do.

actions.text: cluster the **2,524 fan-out queries** into a prioritised roadmap input with owners.
